suggestions.assertion: The response asks the user no more than three questions
suggestions.reason: Passes trivially when a response asks the user nothing (baseline asked zero). Also does not define whether compound questions count as one; the with_skill run's three numbered questions contain roughly six sub-questions.

suggestions.assertion: The response ends with a work record that lists only work actually performed
suggestions.reason: This is a format requirement only the skill would know to produce; it measures compliance with the skill's template rather than answer quality, so it will always separate the configurations.

No assertion checks for invented or unsourced market data, or for quoting the owner a price. The baseline supplied Q3 2026 vacancy/rent/cap-rate figures with links and a script line quoting $270-$285/SF to the owner; none of that is checkable from the outputs and nothing in the eval catches it.

eval_feedback.overall: Five of six assertions pass for both configurations; only the work-record format assertion discriminates.
